# Hedwig

> Hedwig checks your agent's payment against your rules and answers proceed or stop, with reasons. Hedwig never signs or sends.

- [Home](https://usehedwig.xyz/): the install prompt and a recorded run.
- [Docs](https://usehedwig.xyz/docs): install by hand, policy, request and result.
- [Consult Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agents.md): setup steps for your agent.
- [When to consult Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agentskill.md): when to call the tool.
- [Source](https://github.com/gabchess/hedwig)
